record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For the cubic planar family ẋ = ax + by and ẏ = cx³ + dx²y + exy² + fy³, determine whether the maximum possible number of limit cycles is 2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the planar polynomial differential system
$$\dot x = a x + b y, \qquad \dot y = c x^{3} + d x^{2} y + e x y^{2} + f y^{3},$$
where $a,b,c,d,e,f \in \mathbb{R}$. A limit cycle is an isolated periodic orbit of the associated vector field in $\mathbb{R}^{2}$. Let $H(a,b,c,d,e,f)$ denote the number of limit cycles of the system, and let
$$N := \sup_{(a,b,c,d,e,f)\in\mathbb{R}^{6}} H(a,b,c,d,e,f).$$
Determine whether $N = 2$; that is, prove or disprove that the maximum possible number of limit cycles for systems in this family is exactly $2$.
artifact.category_tag: planar polynomial vector fields and limit cycles
artifact.status_search_result: The maximum number of limit cycles for the family "linear plus cubic homogeneous" planar polynomial vector fields is an actively studied question. Recent works (2024–2025) on reversible and algebraic limit cycles in this family establish partial results (uniqueness of certain algebraic limit cycles, bounds on degrees of reversible limit cycles), but no proof or counterexample to the bound 2 for the full family appears in the literature. The problem is listed among open problems in low-dimensional dynamical systems and remains open.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems (Gasull)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3. (i) Consider the cubic family ẋ=ax+by, ẏ=cx^3+dx^2y+exy^2+fy^3. Is 2 its maximum number of limit cycles?
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Reversible Limit Cycles for Linear Plus Cubic Homogeneous Polynomial Differential System
status_evidence.snippet: Studies reversible limit cycles in linear plus cubic homogeneous polynomial systems, providing partial results on degree bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial results exist but do not settle the maximum number of limit cycles in the full family.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic Limit Cycle of Degree 2 for Linear Type Center Plus Cubic Homogeneous Polynomial Differential Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Derives normal form with algebraic limit cycle of degree 2 and shows uniqueness when such a curve is a limit cycle.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial uniqueness results in special subcases are known.
